setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: PowerEditor needs a few tools on this computer and a way to transcribe the audio.
setup.notReady: A few steps are left before the first project.
setup.hint.ffmpeg: Install FFmpeg 7 or newer, or set its path in Settings › General.
setup.hint.ffprobe: ffprobe ships with FFmpeg; set its path if it is not on PATH.
setup.hint.node: Install Node.js 24. On Windows ARM64, rendering needs an x64 Node (path in General).
setup.hint.pnpm: pnpm is enabled through Corepack, included with Node.js 24.
setup.hint.cuda: Without an NVIDIA GPU, Whisper transcribes on the CPU (slower).
setup.openaiInstead: Rather transcribe with OpenAI? Save the key and pick OpenAI as the transcriber.
settings.title: General
settings.language.hint: ISO code, for example es or en. Empty detects the language.
settings.whisperModel.hint: Empty picks one for this computer (now: {model}).
settings.modelMinConfidence.hint: From 0 to 1. Below it the built-in rule is used and the decision is flagged for review.
settings.pathHint: Empty looks the tool up on PATH.
secret.placeholder: Paste the key; it is never shown again
providers.title: AI providers
providers.intro: Register the models you want to use, with an API key or with a local client already signed in on this computer.
providers.empty: No providers. Without them, every feature uses the built-in rules.
providers.label: Name
providers.cliPath.hint: Optional. Empty looks the client up on PATH.
providers.baseUrl.hint: Optional. Empty uses the provider's official address.
providers.confirmCustomUrl: I confirm this URL is trusted and the key is sent there.
providers.deleteConfirm: Delete {label}? Features that use it go back to the built-in rules.
providers.error.label: Enter a name.
providers.error.baseUrl: Use a URL that starts with http:// or https://.
providers.error.confirm: Confirm the custom URL to send the key there.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.claude: Anthropic does not let other apps use Free, Pro or Max plans on the user's behalf. Use Claude Code signed in by you, or better, an API key.
terms.gemini: With a personal Google account, Gemini CLI has a free quota of 1000 requests per day. A long video can use many.
terms.codex: Codex CLI usage counts against your ChatGPT plan's limits and terms.
features.title: AI features
features.intro: Pick which model answers each decision. The built-in rules need no model and are the fallback when a model fails or is unsure.
features.noModels: Enable models in AI providers to assign them.
